name: Rope
summary: Utilize: tie a knot (DC 10 Sleight of Hand); can bind a Grappled, Incapacitated or Restrained creature.
text: As a Utilize action, you can tie a knot with the Rope if you succeed on a DC 10 Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check. A successful DC 20 Strength (Athletics) check bursts the Rope. You can bind an unwilling creature with it only if the creature has the Grappled, Incapacitated, or Restrained condition; if its legs are bound, it has the Restrained condition until it escapes. Escaping takes an action and a successful DC 15 Dexterity (Acrobatics) check.
